text: Woŋkii kala no woniri meeɗay haaɗeeki maayde nden, wata tagaaɗo hoditor oo aduna. Ñalnde Darngal, on yoɓitoyte njoɓdiiji kuuɗe mon ɗen no timmiri hara ɗuytaaki. Kala on Mo Woɗɗiŋtini e yiite ngen O Naadi mo Aljanna, gomɗii on ɗon dañii moƴƴere nde o jortinoo, o daɗii bone mo o hulunoo. Ɗam nguurdam aduna wonaali si wanaa dakammehun lannaykun, ko hodaaɗo tun humondirta e ɗum.
